using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Transactions.TestKit;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Transactions.TestKit.Tests
{
    public class SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrainTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>> _mockData;
        private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _mockLoggerFactory;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain _grain;

        public SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrainTests()
        {
            _mockData = new Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>>();
            _mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

            _mockLoggerFactory
                .Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(_mockLogger.Object);

            // Create grain with mocked dependencies
            var grain = new SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain(_mockData.Object, _mockLoggerFactory.Object);
            
            // Set up protected Grain members using reflection for testing
            typeof(Grain).GetProperty("Runtime")?.SetValue(grain, Mock.Of<IRuntime>());
            typeof(Grain).GetProperty("GrainIdentity")?.SetValue(grain, new GrainIdentity(Guid.NewGuid(), "TestType"));

            _grain = grain;
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task OnActivateAsync_Calls_LogInformation_WithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            string expectedGrainId = _grain.GetPrimaryKey().ToString();
            _mockLoggerFactory
                .Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.Is<string>(name => name == _grain.GetGrainId().ToString())))
                .Returns(_mockLogger.Object);

            _mockLogger
                .Setup(l => l.LogInformation(
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()))
                .Callback<string, object[], Exception>((message, args, ex) =>
                {
                    Assert.Equal("GrainId {GrainId}", message);
                    Assert.Single(args);
                    Assert.Equal(expectedGrainId, args[0]?.ToString());
                });

            // Act
            await _grain.OnActivateAsync(CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            _mockLoggerFactory.Verify(f => f.CreateLogger(It.Is<string>(name => name == _grain.GetGrainId().ToString())), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    "GrainId {GrainId}", 
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0].ToString() == expectedGrainId),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Set_Calls_LogInformation_WithCorrectNewValue()
        {
            // Arrange
            int newValue = 42;
            _mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformUpdate(It.IsAny<Action<GrainData>>()))
                .Callback<Action<GrainData>>(action => action(new GrainData()));

            // Act
            await _grain.Set(newValue);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    "Setting value {NewValue}.",
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0] as int? == newValue),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Add_Calls_LogInformation_WithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            int numberToAdd = 10;
            var grainData = new GrainData { Value = 5 };
            _mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformUpdate(It.IsAny<Action<GrainData>>()))
                .Callback<Action<GrainData>>(action => action(grainData));

            // Act
            await _grain.Add(numberToAdd);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    "Adding {NumberToAdd} to value {Value}.",
                    It.Is<object[]>(args => 
                        args.Length == 2 && 
                        args[0] as int? == numberToAdd && 
                        args[1] as int? == grainData.Value),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Helper class for GrainData (inferred from usage)
    public class GrainData
    {
        public int Value { get; set; }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Transactions.TestKit;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Transactions.TestKit.Tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;

        public LoggerExtensionsTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _mockLogger.Setup(l => l.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_OnActivate_CalledWithCorrectGrainIdFormat()
        {
            // Arrange
            string grainId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
            object[] args = { grainId };

            // Act
            _mockLogger.Object.LogInformation("GrainId {GrainId}", grainId);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>(state => 
                        ExtractMessage(state) == "GrainId {GrainId}" && 
                        ExtractArgs(state).SequenceEqual(args)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_Set_CalledWithCorrectNewValue()
        {
            // Arrange
            int newValue = 42;
            object[] args = { newValue };

            // Act
            _mockLogger.Object.LogInformation("Setting value {NewValue}.", newValue);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>(state => 
                        ExtractMessage(state) == "Setting value {NewValue}." && 
                        ExtractArgs(state).SequenceEqual(args)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_Add_CalledWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            int numberToAdd = 10;
            int currentValue = 5;
            object[] args = { numberToAdd, currentValue };

            // Act
            _mockLogger.Object.LogInformation("Adding {NumberToAdd} to value {Value}.", numberToAdd, currentValue);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>(state => 
                        ExtractMessage(state) == "Adding {NumberToAdd} to value {Value}." && 
                        ExtractArgs(state).SequenceEqual(args)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private static string ExtractMessage(object state)
        {
            if (state is Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.FormattedLogValues formattedLogValues)
            {
                return formattedLogValues.Format;
            }
            return state?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
        }

        private static object[] ExtractArgs(object state)
        {
            if (state is Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.FormattedLogValues formattedLogValues)
            {
                return formattedLogValues.OriginalArguments;
            }
            return Array.Empty<object>();
        }
    }
}

using Orleans.Transactions.TestKit;

namespace Orleans.Transactions.TestKit.Tests

            await _grain.Set(newValue);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Setting value {NewValue}.", It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && (int)args[0] == newValue)), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Add_Calls_LogInformation_WithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            int numberToAdd = 10;
            var grainData = new GrainData { Value = 5 };
            _mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformUpdate(It.IsAny<Action<GrainData>>()))
                .Callback<Action<GrainData>>(action => action(grainData))
                .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            _mockLogger.Setup(l => l.LogInformation("Adding {NumberToAdd} to value {Value}.", It.IsAny<object[]>()));

            // Act
            await _grain.Add(numberToAdd);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(
                "Adding {NumberToAdd} to value {Value}.",
